_rule: A HIGH or CRITICAL advisory in a production dependency fails the gate. An entry here excuses ONE advisory on ONE package, only while no patched version exists, and only until its expiry. scripts/ci/audit_production.mjs fails the gate when an entry has expired, when the advisory's affected range no longer covers the newest published version (a fix exists: upgrade and delete the entry), or when any advisory not listed here appears.

exceptions.reason: ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs. No patched version exists (17 Nov 2026: affected range <=4.0.7, newest published 4.0.7). Reached only through next-intl -> @parcel/watcher, the file watcher next-intl's plugin uses during development; the production site does not watch files or match user-supplied globs. Downgrading @parcel/watcher to 2.5.1 pulls picomatch 2.3.2 through micromatch and raises the count from 2 to 4 HIGH (measured).
